```yaml
name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal

  evaluate:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Run Evaluation
        run: dotnet run --project ./src/SkillValidator/EvaluateCommand.csproj -- --output token-usage.json

      - name: Upload Token Metrics
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: token-usage.json

  dashboard:
    needs: evaluate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Token Metrics
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: .

      - name: Install PowerShell
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y powershell

      - name: Generate Dashboard Data
        run: pwsh ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1

      - name: Upload Dashboard Data
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: dashboard-data.json
```
